record.summary: Observed closeout facts for the Phase 10 campaign, recorded additively after the sealed pre-commit boundary because the issuance-time outcome template is hash-pinned and must remain unpopulated.

relationship_to_issuance.note: outcome/README.md instructs populating codex-job-outcome.json during closeout. Doing so in place would break the sha256 pins held by PACK_MANIFEST.json and EVIDENCE_INDEX_FINAL.json, so this record captures the closeout facts additively instead. This file is deliberately not added to either existing manifest or index, and neither is regenerated.

disposition.distinct_axes_note: Technical completion, substantive acceptance, commit authority, push authority and landing are recorded separately and must not be collapsed into a single status.

authoritative_final_t4.counts_note: The validation record states passed, skipped and exit code only; failed and error counts are not recorded there and are therefore left null rather than invented.

independent_review.final_oracle: reserved sixth launch, MiMo V2.6 Flash, against candidate v6
independent_review.terminal_event: upstream idle timeout during final report emission
independent_review.finding: no candidate-changing defect of any severity was found
independent_review.human_acceptance: Mick explicitly accepted the reconstruction as sufficient campaign evidence; no additional oracle is required or authorized.
independent_review.provenance_note: The reconstruction is evidence of what the oracle executed and concluded, but it is not an independent document and must not be cited as oracle-authored, signed or independently emitted.

accepted_limitations.description: Rerun-synthesis independence is not fully regression-discriminated: re-coupling Rerun-synthesis to the selected worker row's state leaves all 96 fenced tests passing, so the V-2 repair is only half guarded.
Legacy-v1 freshness is not fully regression-discriminated: making version-1 freshness return None leaves the suite green, so the V-5 version guard is unexercised.
Operator pricing entries need not affirm the route or models.
Legacy-mode runs created after Phase 10 carry the additive attempt_number key.
The output panel is hard-capped at 200 px, so per-attempt output is readable scroll-only rather than in an expanded pane.

process_deviations.subject: GLM 5.3 Flash family ceiling
process_deviations.chronology: The original GLM family ceiling of 8 was exceeded before the later Mick-authorized amendment raised the allowance to 14; the overage was then folded into the amended ceiling.
process_deviations.note: Recorded as a supervisor/accounting failure. The sequence must not be rewritten to make the overrun retroactively authorized.

process_deviations.description: The Qwen3.8 broad implementation falsification returned null twice; that work was completed instead on GPT-6 Luna. Both failed launches consumed Qwen3.8 allocation.
One workflow dispatch of the wave-4 GLM workers failed before any child session existed because the script returned un-awaited promises; it was re-dispatched and is recorded as not consumed.
Launch 36 ran the full oracle assignment, completed all nine verification milestones, then died before emitting its report.

budget_and_process.telemetry_note: No campaign-level token total, provider-cost total, allowance-percent telemetry or overall campaign wall-clock total is established by the campaign evidence. Specific validation durations recorded elsewhere in this outcome remain established evidence.

git.implementation_commit_subject: Phase 10: native desktop surface over the headless campaign engine

later_landing_fact.note: Observed directly from Git during this record's preparation. The campaign adjudication itself authorized staging and commit only; how the commit subsequently reached origin/main is a later, separate governance fact not established by the campaign record.

git.push_authority_note: Git proving that the commit later reached origin/main does not establish a later push-authority record. This field records the absence of such a record, not a determination about the complete real-world history of the push.

unresolved_or_unestablished.note: The supporting evidence carries dates, not a precise creation time for this record, so no timestamp is asserted.
Absence of a later authority record; not reconstructed and not retroactively granted.
Requested provider_maximum_if_exposed was not applied because the harness exposes no per-child effort control; recorded as a harness limitation, not a substitution.
The sixth oracle completed its milestones but died before writing its report; only a supervisor reconstruction survives.
All review and validation used deterministic fakes and the offscreen Qt platform.
No live provider call was exercised; operator-supplied rate currentness cannot be machine-verified by design.
This closeout grants no Phase 11 or Phase 12 authority and introduces no new Phase 11 decision.
